decks.title: Classroom & Help Phrases
decks.summary: Phrases for asking your teacher to slow down, repeat, explain meanings/tones, and say things in Chinese.

cards.front: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn, màn yì diǎn
cards.pinyin: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn, màn yì diǎn
cards.meaning: could you say that again, more slowly?
cards.example: 对不起，请再说一遍，慢一点。
cards.examplePinyin: duì bu qǐ, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn, màn yì diǎn.
cards.promptZh: 老师说得太快，你没听懂，想请他再说一次、说慢一点，可以说什么？
cards.promptPinyin: lǎoshī shuō de tài kuài, nǐ méi tīng dǒng, xiǎng qǐng tā zài shuō yí cì, shuō màn yìdiǎn, kěyǐ shuō shénme?
cards.promptEn: The teacher spoke too fast and you didn't catch it — ask them to repeat it more slowly. (please say it again, more slowly)

cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge cí shì shén me yì si?
cards.promptZh: 你听到一个词，不知道它的意思，想问老师，可以怎么问？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ tīng dào yí ge cí, bù zhīdào tā de yìsi, xiǎng wèn lǎoshī, kěyǐ zěnme wèn?
cards.promptEn: You heard a word but don't know its meaning — ask the teacher. (what does ... mean?)

cards.front: kě yǐ zài tīng yí biàn ma?
cards.pinyin: kě yǐ zài tīng yí biàn ma?
cards.meaning: can we listen to it one more time?
cards.examplePinyin: lǎo shī, kě yǐ zài tīng yí biàn ma?
cards.promptZh: 你没听懂那段话，想再听一次，可以客气地问什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ méi tīng dǒng nà duàn huà, xiǎng zài tīng yí cì, kěyǐ kèqi de wèn shénme?
cards.promptEn: You didn't hear that clearly and want to hear it once more — how do you ask? (can we listen one more time?)

cards.front: zhè ge cí wǒ bú rèn shi
cards.pinyin: zhè ge cí wǒ bú rèn shi
cards.example: 这个词我不认识，是什么意思？
cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge cí wǒ bú rèn shi, shì shén me yì si?
cards.promptZh: 你看到一个词，完全不知道是什么，想告诉老师，可以说什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ kàn dào yí ge cí, wánquán bù zhīdào shì shénme, xiǎng gàosu lǎoshī, kěyǐ shuō shénme?
cards.promptEn: You see a word and have no idea what it is — tell the teacher. (I don't know that word)

cards.front: zhè ge cí shì jǐ shēng?
cards.pinyin: zhè ge cí shì jǐ shēng?
cards.examplePinyin: qǐng wèn, zhè ge cí shì jǐ shēng?
cards.promptZh: 你想知道一个词是第几声，可以问老师什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhīdào yí ge cí shì dì jǐ shēng, kěyǐ wèn lǎoshī shénme?
cards.promptEn: You want to know what tone a word is — ask the teacher. (what tone is that word?)

cards.front: zhè ge shì yì shēng hái shì sān shēng?
cards.pinyin: zhè ge shì yì shēng hái shì sān shēng?
cards.meaning: is that first tone or third tone?
cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge shì yì shēng hái shì sān shēng?
cards.promptZh: 你不知道一个词是第一声还是第三声，想知道是哪个，可以怎么问？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ bù zhīdào yí ge cí shì dì yī shēng háishì dì sān shēng, xiǎng wèn qīngchu, kěyǐ zěnme wèn?
cards.promptEn: You're unsure if a word is first or third tone — ask to clarify. (is it first or third tone?)

cards.front: zhè ge cí wǒ hái bú huì
cards.pinyin: zhè ge cí wǒ hái bú huì
cards.meaning: I don't know that word yet
cards.example: 这个词我还不会，可以教我吗？
cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge cí wǒ hái bú huì, kě yǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
cards.promptZh: 有一个词你还没学会，想告诉老师你现在还不会，可以说什么？
cards.promptPinyin: yǒu yí ge cí nǐ hái méi xué huì, xiǎng gàosu lǎoshī nǐ xiànzài hái bú huì, kěyǐ shuō shénme?
cards.promptEn: There's a word you haven't learned yet — tell the teacher you don't know it yet. (I don't know that word yet)

cards.front: ... yòng zhōng wén zěn me shuō?
cards.pinyin: ... yòng zhōng wén zěn me shuō?
cards.meaning: how do you say ... in Chinese?
cards.examplePinyin: "apple" yòng zhōng wén zěn me shuō?
cards.promptZh: 你知道一个东西的英文，但不知道中文，想问老师，可以怎么问？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ zhīdào yí ge dōngxi de yīngwén, dàn bù zhīdào zhōngwén, xiǎng wèn lǎoshī, kěyǐ zěnme wèn?
cards.promptEn: You know something's English name but not the Chinese — ask the teacher. (how do you say ... in Chinese?)

cards.front: zhè ge zì wǒ bú rèn shi
cards.pinyin: zhè ge zì wǒ bú rèn shi
cards.meaning: I don't know how to read this (character)
cards.example: 不好意思，这个字我不认识。
cards.examplePinyin: bù hǎo yì si, zhè ge zì wǒ bú rèn shi.
cards.promptZh: 你看到一个字，不知道怎么读，想告诉老师，可以说什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ kàn dào yí ge zì, bù zhīdào zěnme dú, xiǎng gàosu lǎoshī, kěyǐ shuō shénme?
cards.promptEn: You see a character and don't know how to read it — tell the teacher. (I don't know how to read this)

cards.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng yǒu yì fú huà.
cards.promptZh: 房间的四____都是白色的。
cards.promptPinyin: fángjiān de sì ____ dōu shì báisè de.
cards.promptEn: The four ____ (walls) of the room are all white.

cards.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi.

cards.promptPinyin: fángjiān hěn rè, qǐng dǎkāi ____.
cards.promptEn: The room is hot, please open the ____ (window).

cards.meaning: floor (of a room, e.g. wooden floor)
cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge gōng yù shì mù dì bǎn.
cards.promptZh: 房间最下面、我们走在上面的那个是____。
cards.promptPinyin: fángjiān zuì xiàmiàn, wǒmen zǒu zài shàngmiàn de nàge shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The lowest part of the room, that we walk on, is the ____ (floor).

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zhǎo bu dào wǒ de yào shi.
cards.promptZh: 出门以前别忘了拿____，不然回不了家。
cards.promptPinyin: chūmén yǐqián bié wàng le ná ____, bùrán huí bù liǎo jiā.
cards.promptEn: Don't forget to take your ____ (keys) before going out, or you can't get back home.

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ men zuò diàn tī shàng qù ba.
cards.promptZh: 我家在十楼，上去要坐____。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ jiā zài shí lóu, shàngqù yào zuò ____.
cards.promptEn: My home is on the 10th floor, you take the ____ (elevator) up.

cards.examplePinyin: zhè shì wǒ de yá shuā.
cards.promptZh: 刷牙的时候要用____。
cards.promptPinyin: shuā yá de shíhou yào yòng ____.
cards.promptEn: When brushing your teeth you use a ____ (toothbrush).

cards.examplePinyin: tā xǐ le liǎn.
cards.promptZh: 早上起床以后，我先去洗____。
cards.promptPinyin: zǎoshang qǐchuáng yǐhòu, wǒ xiān qù xǐ ____.
cards.promptEn: After getting up, I first go wash my ____ (face).

cards.examplePinyin: měi tiān yào shuā yá chǐ.
cards.promptZh: 吃完东西要刷____。
cards.promptPinyin: chī wán dōngxi yào shuā ____.
cards.promptEn: After eating you should brush your ____ (teeth).

cards.examplePinyin: niú nǎi zài bīng xiāng lǐ.
cards.promptZh: 牛奶和菜要放在____里面。
cards.promptPinyin: niúnǎi hé cài yào fàng zài ____ lǐmiàn.
cards.promptEn: Milk and food should be kept in the ____ (fridge).

cards.examplePinyin: yòng wēi bō lú rè yí xià fàn.
cards.promptZh: 想让饭快一点变热，可以用____。
cards.promptPinyin: xiǎng ràng fàn kuài yìdiǎn biàn rè, kěyǐ yòng ____.
cards.promptEn: To heat food up quickly, you can use the ____ (microwave).

cards.examplePinyin: tā zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn shì.
cards.promptZh: 看电视的时候，我喜欢坐在____上。
cards.promptPinyin: kàn diànshì de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan zuò zài ____ shàng.
cards.promptEn: When watching TV, I like to sit on the ____ (sofa).

cards.examplePinyin: chuāng biān yǒu yì pén zhí wù.
cards.promptZh: 树和花都是____。
cards.promptPinyin: shù hé huā dōu shì ____.
cards.promptEn: Trees and flowers are both ____ (plants).

cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge dēng hěn liàng.
cards.promptZh: 房间太黑了，请开一下____。
cards.promptPinyin: fángjiān tài hēi le, qǐng kāi yíxià ____.
cards.promptEn: The room is too dark, please turn on the ____ (light).

cards.examplePinyin: tiān hēi le, kāi dēng ba.
cards.promptZh: 房间很黑，我要____。
cards.promptPinyin: fángjiān hěn hēi, wǒ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: The room is dark, I'll ____ (turn on the light).

cards.examplePinyin: shuì jiào qián qǐng guān dēng.
cards.promptZh: 要睡觉了，请____。
cards.promptPinyin: yào shuìjiào le, qǐng ____.
cards.promptEn: Time to sleep, please ____ (turn off the light).

cards.examplePinyin: xī chén qì huài le.
cards.promptZh: 地上要打扫的时候，要用____。
cards.promptPinyin: dì shàng yào dǎsǎo de shíhou, yào yòng ____.
cards.promptEn: When the floor needs cleaning, you use a ____ (vacuum).

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zài kè tīng xī chén.
cards.promptZh: 我每个星期都会在家里____一次。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ měi ge xīngqī dōu huì zài jiā lǐ ____ yí cì.
cards.promptEn: I ____ (vacuum) at home once every week.

cards.examplePinyin: wà zi zài chōu ti lǐ.
cards.promptZh: 我的袜子放在桌子下面的____里。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ de wàzi fàng zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn de ____ lǐ.
cards.promptEn: My socks are in the ____ (drawer) under the desk.

cards.examplePinyin: gěi wǒ yì tiáo máo jīn.
cards.promptZh: 洗完脸以后，用____把脸吹干。
cards.promptPinyin: xǐ wán liǎn yǐhòu, yòng ____ bǎ liǎn chuī gān.
cards.promptEn: After washing your face, dry it with a ____ (towel).

cards.examplePinyin: yòng chuī fēng jī chuī gān tóu fa.
cards.promptZh: 洗完头发以后，我用____把头发吹干。
cards.promptPinyin: xǐ wán tóufa yǐhòu, wǒ yòng ____ bǎ tóufa chuī gān.
cards.promptEn: After washing my hair, I dry it with a ____ (hair dryer).

cards.examplePinyin: dàn gāo zài kǎo xiāng lǐ.
cards.promptZh: 做蛋糕的时候，要把它放进____里。
cards.promptPinyin: zuò dàngāo de shíhou, yào bǎ tā fàng jìn ____ lǐ.
cards.promptEn: When making a cake, you put it into the ____ (oven).

cards.examplePinyin: bǎ pán zi fàng jìn xǐ wǎn jī.
cards.promptZh: 吃完饭，碗可以放进____里洗。
cards.promptPinyin: chī wán fàn, wǎn kěyǐ fàng jìn ____ lǐ xǐ.
cards.promptEn: After eating, dishes can go in the ____ (dishwasher) to be washed.

cards.examplePinyin: wǎn zài shuǐ cáo lǐ.
cards.promptZh: 厨房里洗菜、洗碗的那个地方是____。
cards.promptPinyin: chúfáng lǐ xǐ cài, xǐ wǎn de nàge dìfang shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The place in the kitchen for washing veg and dishes is the ____ (sink).

cards.examplePinyin: yù shì zài lóu shàng.
cards.promptZh: 我在____里洗澡。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ zài ____ lǐ xǐzǎo.
cards.promptEn: I shower in the ____ (bathroom).

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ yào qù xǐ zǎo.
cards.promptZh: 运动完以后，我要去____。
cards.promptPinyin: yùndòng wán yǐhòu, wǒ yào qù ____.
cards.promptEn: After exercising, I'm going to ____ (take a shower).

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zài shuā yá, děng yí xià.
cards.promptZh: 你早上拿着牙刷，在洗手间里，你在做什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ zǎoshang ná zhe yáshuā, zài xǐshǒujiān lǐ, nǐ zài zuò shénme?

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zài chuī tóu fa, hěn chǎo.

cards.promptPinyin: nǐ xǐ wán tóu, ná zhe chuīfēngjī, nǐ zài zuò shénme?
cards.promptEn: You've washed your hair and are holding a hair dryer — what are you doing? (I'm drying my hair)

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zài xǐ liǎn, mǎ shàng hǎo.
cards.promptZh: 你早上在水槽前面，用水和毛巾，你在做什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ zǎoshang zài shuǐcáo qiánmiàn, yòng shuǐ hé máojīn, nǐ zài zuò shénme?
cards.promptEn: You're at the sink in the morning with water and a towel — what are you doing? (I'm washing my face)

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài yí ge xiǎo gōng yù.
cards.promptZh: 我不住在大房子里，我住在一个____里。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ bú zhù zài dà fángzi lǐ, wǒ zhù zài yí ge ____ lǐ.
cards.promptEn: I don't live in a big house, I live in an ____ (apartment).

cards.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ yào dǎ sǎo.
cards.promptZh: 家里东西太多了，星期天我要好好____一下。
cards.promptPinyin: jiā lǐ dōngxi tài duō le, xīngqītiān wǒ yào hǎohǎo ____ yíxià.
cards.promptEn: There's too much stuff at home, on Sunday I'll ____ (clean/tidy) it up well.

cards.front: wǒ zài dǎ sǎo gōng yù
cards.pinyin: wǒ zài dǎ sǎo gōng yù
cards.examplePinyin: wǒ zài dǎ sǎo gōng yù, yǒu diǎn luàn.
cards.promptZh: 你拿着吸尘器，在家里打扫，你在做什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ ná zhe xīchénqì, zài jiā lǐ dǎsǎo, nǐ zài zuò shénme?
cards.promptEn: You're holding a vacuum, cleaning at home — what are you doing? (I'm cleaning the apartment)

cards.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhěn tou hěn ruǎn.
cards.promptZh: 睡觉的时候，头下面放着____。
cards.promptPinyin: shuìjiào de shíhou, tóu xiàmiàn fàng zhe ____.
cards.promptEn: When sleeping, there's a ____ (pillow) under your head.

cards.examplePinyin: tiān lěng le, gài shàng tǎn zi.
cards.promptZh: 天冷的时候，睡觉身上要放一张____。
cards.promptPinyin: tiān lěng de shíhou, shuìjiào shēn shàng yào fàng yì zhāng ____.
cards.promptEn: When it's cold, you put a ____ (blanket) over you when sleeping.

cards.examplePinyin: kè tīng lǐ yǒu yí ge shā fā.
cards.promptZh: 家里放沙发、看电视的那个房间是____。
cards.promptPinyin: jiā lǐ fàng shāfā, kàn diànshì de nàge fángjiān shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The room with the sofa where you watch TV is the ____ (living room).

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ de wò shì hěn xiǎo.
cards.promptZh: 放床、睡觉的那个房间是____。
cards.promptPinyin: fàng chuáng, shuìjiào de nàge fángjiān shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The room with the bed where you sleep is the ____ (bedroom).

cards.examplePinyin: yī fu dōu zài yī guì lǐ.
cards.promptZh: 我的衣服都放在卧室的____里。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ de yīfu dōu fàng zài wòshì de ____ lǐ.
cards.promptEn: My clothes are all kept in the ____ (closet) in the bedroom.

cards.front: wǒ men zhù zài yí ge liǎng fáng de gōng yù
cards.pinyin: wǒ men zhù zài yí ge liǎng fáng de gōng yù
cards.meaning: we live in a two-bedroom apartment
cards.example: 我们住在一个两房的公寓，离公司很近。

cards.hanzi: 我们住在一个两房的公寓

cards.examplePinyin: wǒ yǒu shí hou hē kā fēi.

cards.promptPinyin: wǒ chángcháng hē chá, ____ yě hē kāfēi.

decks.title: Jobs and Workplace Vocabulary
decks.summary: This homework covers common workplace and profession vocabulary in Mandarin. Students will learn how to talk about companies, offices, and various jobs. The lesson also introduces the measure word 'jia' for companies and stores, and a useful sentence for asking about someone's occupation.

cards.example: wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī gōngzuò
cards.promptZh: 我每天去____上班，做我的工作。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ měitiān qù ____ shàngbān, zuò wǒ de gōngzuò.
cards.promptEn: I go to the ____ (company) to work every day.

cards.meaning: measure word for companies, stores, restaurants
cards.notes: Used when counting businesses or establishments
cards.promptZh: 这条街上有三____饭店。
cards.promptPinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu sān ____ fàndiàn.
cards.promptEn: There are three ____ (measure word) restaurants on this street.

cards.promptZh: 我在公司里的____工作，桌子上有电脑。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ zài gōngsī lǐ de ____ gōngzuò, zhuōzi shàng yǒu diànnǎo.
cards.promptEn: I work in the ____ (office) at the company, there's a computer on the desk.

cards.promptZh: 做买卖、开公司的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zuò mǎimài, kāi gōngsī de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who does business and runs companies is a ____ (businessperson).

cards.promptZh: 你跟别人有很大的问题，可以请一个____帮你说话。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ gēn biéren yǒu hěn dà de wèntí, kěyǐ qǐng yí ge ____ bāng nǐ shuō huà.
cards.promptEn: If you have a big dispute with someone, you can hire a ____ (lawyer) to speak for you.

cards.promptZh: 在大学里教书的老师叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài dàxué lǐ jiāo shū de lǎoshī jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A teacher who teaches at a university is called a ____ (professor).

cards.promptZh: 你病了，要去医院看____。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ bìng le, yào qù yīyuàn kàn ____.
cards.promptEn: You're sick, you go to the hospital to see a ____ (doctor).

cards.promptZh: 用中药给人看病的医生叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: yòng zhōngyào gěi rén kàn bìng de yīshēng jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A doctor who treats people with Chinese medicine is a ____ (TCM doctor).

cards.promptZh: 用西药看病的医生叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: yòng xīyào kàn bìng de yīshēng jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A doctor who treats illness with Western medicine is a ____ (Western doctor).

cards.promptZh: 在医院里帮医生看病人的人是____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài yīyuàn lǐ bāng yīshēng kàn bìngrén de rén shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The person in a hospital who helps the doctor with patients is a ____ (nurse).

cards.promptZh: 一个很会画画的人，我们可以叫他____。
cards.promptPinyin: yí ge hěn huì huà huà de rén, wǒmen kěyǐ jiào tā ____.
cards.promptEn: Someone who is very good at painting, we can call an ____ (artist).

cards.promptZh: 写书的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: xiě shū de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who writes books is an ____ (author).

cards.promptZh: 做音乐、很会玩音乐的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zuò yīnyuè, hěn huì wán yīnyuè de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who makes music and is skilled at it is a ____ (musician).

cards.promptZh: 开车的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: kāi chē de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: The person who drives the car is the ____ (driver).

cards.promptZh: 在电影里面的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài diànyǐng lǐmiàn de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who appears in movies is an ____ (actor).

cards.promptZh: 每天运动、比别人跑得快的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: měitiān yùndòng, bǐ biéren pǎo de kuài de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who trains every day and runs faster than others is an ____ (athlete).

cards.notes: Used to call a server in a restaurant
cards.promptZh: 在饭店里给我们点菜、上菜的人是____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài fàndiàn lǐ gěi wǒmen diǎn cài, shàng cài de rén shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The person who takes and brings our food at the restaurant is a ____ (waiter).

cards.promptZh: 在地里种菜、种水果的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài dì lǐ zhòng cài, zhòng shuǐguǒ de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who grows vegetables and fruit on the land is a ____ (farmer).

cards.promptZh: 公司里每天和钱打交道、看公司有多少钱的人是____。
cards.promptPinyin: gōngsī lǐ měitiān hé qián dǎ jiāodào, kàn gōngsī yǒu duōshao qián de rén shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The person at the company who deals with money every day and tracks how much the company has is an ____ (accountant).

cards.notes: Can be used as noun or verb
cards.promptZh: 我每天早上九点开始____。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ měitiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ ____.
cards.promptEn: I start ____ (work) at nine every morning.

cards.notes: Used here to mean 'do' in the context of work
cards.promptZh: 你在____什么？我在看书。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ zài ____ shénme? wǒ zài kàn shū.
cards.promptEn: What are you ____ (doing)? I'm reading.

decks.title: Asking for Directions
decks.summary: This homework covers essential vocabulary and phrases for asking and giving directions in Mandarin. Students will learn how to say left, right, straight, and how to politely ask for directions to a place. Useful everyday phrases like getting on/off transportation and saying goodbye are also included.

cards.notes: Used before a direction to indicate 'toward that direction'
cards.promptZh: ____前走就到了。
cards.promptPinyin: ____ qián zǒu jiù dào le.
cards.promptEn: Go ____ (toward) the front and you'll arrive.

cards.promptZh: 我用这只手写字，这只手是____手。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ yòng zhè zhī shǒu xiě zì, zhè zhī shǒu shì ____ shǒu.
cards.promptEn: I write with this hand; this is my ____ (left) hand.

cards.promptZh: 到了前面的路口，你要____。
cards.promptPinyin: dào le qiánmiàn de lùkǒu, nǐ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: At the intersection ahead, you need to ____ (turn left).

cards.notes: More complete/polite way to say turn left
cards.promptZh: 不要往右，到了那里要____。
cards.promptPinyin: bú yào wǎng yòu, dào le nàlǐ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: Not to the right — when you get there, ____ (turn to the left).

cards.promptZh: 大部分人写字用的那只手是____手。
cards.promptPinyin: dà bùfen rén xiě zì yòng de nà zhī shǒu shì ____ shǒu.
cards.promptEn: The hand most people write with is the ____ (right) hand.

cards.promptZh: 不要往左，到了路口你要____。
cards.promptPinyin: bú yào wǎng zuǒ, dào le lùkǒu nǐ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: Not to the left — at the intersection you need to ____ (turn right).

cards.promptZh: 看到那家店以后，你要____。
cards.promptPinyin: kàn dào nà jiā diàn yǐhòu, nǐ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: After you see that shop, you ____ (turn to the right).

cards.promptZh: 不往左也不往右，就是一____往前。
cards.promptPinyin: bù wǎng zuǒ yě bù wǎng yòu, jiùshì yì ____ wǎng qián.
cards.promptEn: Not left or right, just ____ (straight) ahead.

cards.promptZh: 不要拐，往前____就到了。
cards.promptPinyin: bú yào guǎi, wǎng qián ____ jiù dào le.
cards.promptEn: Don't turn, just ____ (go straight) ahead and you'll arrive.

cards.notes: Often used with 'de' to mean 'near something'
cards.promptZh: 我家____有一家很好的饭店，走路几分钟就到。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ jiā ____ yǒu yì jiā hěn hǎo de fàndiàn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
cards.promptEn: There's a good restaurant ____ (nearby) my home, a few minutes' walk away.

cards.meaning: get on (a bus, train, plane, etc.)
cards.promptZh: 公交车来了，我们快____。
cards.promptPinyin: gōngjiāochē lái le, wǒmen kuài ____.
cards.promptEn: The bus is here, let's quickly ____ (get on).

cards.meaning: get off (a bus, train, plane, etc.)
cards.promptZh: 到站了，我要____。
cards.promptPinyin: dào zhàn le, wǒ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: We've reached the stop, I need to ____ (get off).

cards.meaning: excuse me (polite way to ask a question)
cards.notes: Very useful phrase to start any question to a stranger
cards.promptZh: 你想问路人一个问题，可以先客气地说____。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ xiǎng wèn lùrén yí ge wèntí, kěyǐ xiān kèqi de shuō ____.
cards.promptEn: To ask a stranger a question, you politely begin with ____ (excuse me).

cards.promptZh: 请问，去火车站怎么走？我想____那里。
cards.promptPinyin: qǐngwèn, qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu? wǒ xiǎng ____ nàlǐ.
cards.promptEn: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station? I want to ____ (arrive at) there.

cards.promptZh: 请问去你家____走？
cards.promptPinyin: qǐngwèn qù nǐ jiā ____ zǒu?
cards.promptEn: Excuse me, ____ (how) do I get to your home?

cards.promptZh: 我不坐车，我想____路去。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ bú zuò chē, wǒ xiǎng ____ lù qù.
cards.promptEn: I'm not taking a car, I want to ____ (walk) there.

cards.notes: Common expression of happiness or relief
cards.promptZh: 你帮了我很大的忙，____，谢谢你！
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng, ____, xièxie nǐ!
cards.promptEn: You helped me a lot — ____ (that's great), thank you!

cards.promptZh: 你病了，要____休息，别工作。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ bìng le, yào ____ xiūxi, bié gōngzuò.
cards.promptEn: You're sick, you need to rest ____ (properly), don't work.

cards.promptZh: 请你____我，去车站怎么走。
cards.promptPinyin: qǐng nǐ ____ wǒ, qù chēzhàn zěnme zǒu.
cards.promptEn: Please ____ (tell) me how to get to the station.

cards.notes: Literally 'walk slowly'; a friendly way to say goodbye
cards.promptZh: 客人要走的时候，我们常常客气地说____。
cards.promptPinyin: kèrén yào zǒu de shíhou, wǒmen chángcháng kèqi de shuō ____.
cards.promptEn: When a guest is leaving, we often politely say ____ (take care).

cards.promptZh: 这个____很好看，我想在这里拍照。
cards.promptPinyin: zhège ____ hěn hǎokàn, wǒ xiǎng zài zhèlǐ pāizhào.
cards.promptEn: This ____ (place) is beautiful, I want to take a photo here.

decks.title: Transportation and Daily Commuting
decks.summary: This homework covers vocabulary and grammar related to transportation and daily commuting. The student will learn how to talk about different modes of transport (bus, train, subway, taxi, bike, motorcycle, boat, plane), describe commuting experiences, and express opinions about convenience and comfort. The material also practices time expressions and comparing experiences in different cities.

cards.promptZh: 很多人一起坐的、在路上开的大车是____。

decks.title: Shopping & Phone Calls - Chit Chat Chinese Ch. 11 Continued
decks.summary: This homework covers shopping vocabulary and dialogues (buying clothes, asking prices, trying things on), making phone calls and plans in Mandarin, the V-yi-V pattern for 'giving something a try,' and using 'zai' to express ongoing actions (-ing). Cultural notes on colors in Chinese culture are also included.

cards.promptEn: Someone calls you, the first thing you say when picking up is ____ (hello).

cards.promptZh: 我们明天几点____？在哪里？

decks.title: Restaurant Dining and Useful Expressions

cards.example: qǐng lái càidān = please bring a menu
cards.promptZh: 我们还不知道吃什么，请给我们一个____。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒmen hái bù zhīdào chī shénme, qǐng gěi wǒmen yí ge ____.
cards.promptEn: We don't know what to eat yet, please give us a ____ (menu).

cards.example: xiǎojiě, mǎidān = miss, the bill please
cards.promptZh: 吃完饭了，服务员，我要____。
cards.promptPinyin: chī wán fàn le, fúwùyuán, wǒ yào ____.
cards.promptEn: We've finished eating, waiter, I'd like the ____ (bill).

cards.promptZh: 你想喝什么____？茶还是啤酒？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ xiǎng hē shénme ____? chá háishì píjiǔ?
cards.promptEn: What ____ (drink) would you like? Tea or beer?

cards.example: liǎng bēi chá = two cups of tea
cards.promptZh: 中国人吃饭的时候，常常喝____。
cards.promptPinyin: zhōngguó rén chī fàn de shíhou, chángcháng hē ____.
cards.promptEn: Chinese people often drink ____ (tea) with meals.

cards.example: qǐng lái yì píng píjiǔ = please bring a bottle of beer
cards.promptZh: 很多人吃饭的时候喜欢喝一点____。
cards.promptPinyin: hěn duō rén chī fàn de shíhou xǐhuan hē yìdiǎn ____.
cards.promptEn: Many people like to drink some ____ (beer) with their meal.

cards.promptZh: 我想吃牛做的肉，就是____。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ xiǎng chī niú zuò de ròu, jiùshì ____.
cards.promptEn: I want meat from a cow, that is ____ (beef).

cards.promptZh: 饺子里面常常放的那种肉是____。
cards.promptPinyin: jiǎozi lǐmiàn chángcháng fàng de nà zhǒng ròu shì ____.
cards.promptEn: The meat often put inside dumplings is ____ (pork).

cards.promptZh: 鸡身上的肉叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: jī shēn shàng de ròu jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: The meat from a chicken is called ____ (chicken meat).

cards.promptZh: 一种里面放肉和菜、中国人很爱吃的东西是____。
cards.promptPinyin: yì zhǒng lǐmiàn fàng ròu hé cài, zhōngguó rén hěn ài chī de dōngxi shì ____.
cards.promptEn: A food with meat and veg inside that Chinese people love is ____ (dumplings).

cards.promptZh: 炒出来的面叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: chǎo chūlái de miàn jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: Stir-fried noodles are called ____ (chow mein).

cards.promptZh: 炒出来的饭叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: chǎo chūlái de fàn jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: Stir-fried rice is called ____ (fried rice).

cards.notes: Chinese say 'hē tāng' (drink soup), not 'eat soup'
cards.promptZh: 天冷的时候，喝一碗热____很舒服。
cards.promptPinyin: tiān lěng de shíhou, hē yì wǎn rè ____ hěn shūfu.
cards.promptEn: When it's cold, a bowl of hot ____ (soup) feels nice.

cards.promptZh: 中国人吃饭用____，不用叉子。
cards.promptPinyin: zhōngguó rén chī fàn yòng ____, bú yòng chāzi.
cards.promptEn: Chinese people eat with ____ (chopsticks), not a fork.

cards.example: wǒmen lái gānbēi ba = let's cheers
cards.notes: sometimes literally means empty your glass
cards.promptZh: 大家一起喝酒，很开心，想一起把杯子里的酒喝完，会说什么？
cards.promptPinyin: dàjiā yìqǐ hē jiǔ, hěn kāixīn, xiǎng yìqǐ bǎ bēizi lǐ de jiǔ hē wán, huì shuō shénme?
cards.promptEn: Everyone's drinking happily and wants to finish their glasses together — what do you say? (cheers)

decks.title: Introductions and Nationalities
decks.summary: This homework covers how to introduce yourself, ask someone's name and surname, and ask/state nationalities. It includes formal and informal greetings, yes/no questions with 'ma', question words like 'shenme', 'na', and 'shei', and the abbreviated question particle 'ne'.

cards.notes: Used when addressing elders or in formal situations
cards.promptZh: 对老人说话要客气，可以叫____，不叫你。
cards.promptPinyin: duì lǎorén shuōhuà yào kèqi, kěyǐ jiào ____, bú jiào nǐ.
cards.promptEn: To be polite to elders, you say ____ (formal 'you') instead of 你.

cards.meaning: May I ask your last name?
cards.notes: Polite way to ask someone's surname
cards.promptZh: 你想客气地问一个人姓什么，可以问他____？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ xiǎng kèqi de wèn yí ge rén xìng shénme, kěyǐ wèn tā ____?
cards.promptEn: To politely ask someone's surname, you ask them ____? (your honorable surname?)

cards.notes: Used as both a verb and noun
cards.promptZh: 我爸爸姓王，所以我也____王。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ bàba xìng wáng, suǒyǐ wǒ yě ____ wáng.
cards.promptEn: My dad's surname is Wang, so my ____ (surname) is also Wang.

cards.promptZh: 中国人很多人姓这个，是一个很常见的姓，比如____老师。
cards.promptPinyin: zhōngguó rén hěn duō rén xìng zhège, shì yí ge hěn chángjiàn de xìng, bǐrú ____ lǎoshī.
cards.promptEn: A very common Chinese surname, e.g. Teacher ____ (Li).

cards.promptZh: 还有一个很常见的中国姓，比如____先生。
cards.promptPinyin: hái yǒu yí ge hěn chángjiàn de zhōngguó xìng, bǐrú ____ xiānsheng.
cards.promptEn: Another very common Chinese surname, e.g. Mr. ____ (Wang).

cards.notes: Can also mean 'husband' in everyday speech
cards.promptZh: 对一个男人客气，我们可以叫他____。
cards.promptPinyin: duì yí ge nánrén kèqi, wǒmen kěyǐ jiào tā ____.
cards.promptEn: To politely address a man, we call him ____ (Mr./Sir).

cards.promptZh: 说自己的时候，用____这个字。
cards.promptPinyin: shuō zìjǐ de shíhou, yòng ____ zhège zì.
cards.promptEn: When talking about yourself, you use the word ____ (I/me).

cards.notes: Used for full name or given name
cards.promptZh: 你好，我____李明，很高兴认识你。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ hǎo, wǒ ____ lǐ míng, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
cards.promptEn: Hello, I'm ____ (called) Li Ming, nice to meet you.

cards.promptZh: 见面的时候，我们常常说“你____”。
cards.promptPinyin: jiànmiàn de shíhou, wǒmen chángcháng shuō “nǐ ____”.
cards.promptEn: When we meet, we often say 'you ____' (hello/good).

cards.promptZh: 我____中国人，他也____中国人。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ ____ zhōngguó rén, tā yě ____ zhōngguó rén.
cards.promptEn: I ____ (am) Chinese, he ____ (is) Chinese too.

cards.promptZh: 住在美国、从美国来的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zhù zài měiguó, cóng měiguó lái de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person from America is called an ____ (American).

cards.promptZh: 一个在西方、很大、很多人想去的国家是____。
cards.promptPinyin: yí ge zài xīfāng, hěn dà, hěn duō rén xiǎng qù de guójiā shì ____.
cards.promptEn: A large Western country that many people want to visit is ____ (America).

cards.promptPinyin: zhōng____, měi____, yīng____, dōu shì ____jiā.
cards.promptEn: China, America, Britain are all ____ (countries).

cards.promptZh: 我是一个____，不是动物。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ shì yí ge ____, bú shì dòngwù.
cards.promptEn: I'm a ____ (person), not an animal.

cards.example: ni shi Li xian sheng ma?
cards.notes: Added at end of statement to make it a yes/no question
cards.promptZh: 问别人是不是的时候，最后放一个____。比如：你是老师____？
cards.promptPinyin: wèn biéren shì bú shì de shíhou, zuìhòu fàng yí ge ____. bǐrú: nǐ shì lǎoshī ____?
cards.promptEn: To ask a yes/no question, you put ____ at the end, e.g. 'you are a teacher ____?'

cards.notes: Changes to 2nd tone before another 4th tone: bu shi becomes bu(2) shi
cards.promptZh: 我____是美国人，我是中国人。
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ ____ shì měiguó rén, wǒ shì zhōngguó rén.
cards.promptEn: I'm ____ (not) American, I'm Chinese.

cards.example: ta bu shi Ying guo ren
cards.promptZh: 一个在西方、说英文、不是美国的国家是____。
cards.promptPinyin: yí ge zài xīfāng, shuō yīngwén, bú shì měiguó de guójiā shì ____.
cards.promptEn: A Western, English-speaking country that isn't America is ____ (Britain).

cards.example: ni shi Li Ai mei ma?
cards.promptZh: 说对方的时候，用____这个字。____好！
cards.promptPinyin: shuō duìfāng de shíhou, yòng ____ zhège zì. ____ hǎo!
cards.promptEn: When talking to the other person, use the word ____ (you). Hello!

cards.promptZh: 你叫____名字？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ jiào ____ míngzi?
cards.promptEn: ____ (What) is your name?

cards.example: ni jiao shen me ming zi?
cards.notes: Can refer to full name or first name
cards.promptZh: 你好，请问你的____是什么？
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn nǐ de ____ shì shénme?
cards.promptEn: Hello, may I ask what your ____ (name) is?

cards.promptZh: 你是____国人？我是中国人。
cards.promptPinyin: nǐ shì ____ guó rén? wǒ shì zhōngguó rén.
cards.promptEn: ____ (Which) country are you from? I'm Chinese.

cards.promptZh: 我很好，你____？
cards.promptPinyin: wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ____?
cards.promptEn: I'm fine, and you ____? (how about you?)

cards.promptZh: 台北在哪里？在____。
cards.promptPinyin: táiběi zài nǎlǐ? zài ____.
cards.promptEn: Taipei is where? In ____ (Taiwan).

cards.promptZh: 那个男人是我的朋友，____是老师。
cards.promptPinyin: nàge nánrén shì wǒ de péngyou, ____ shì lǎoshī.
cards.promptEn: That man is my friend, ____ (he) is a teacher.

cards.promptZh: 上海在哪个国家？在____。
cards.promptPinyin: shànghǎi zài nǎge guójiā? zài ____.
cards.promptEn: Shanghai is in which country? In ____ (China).

cards.notes: Sounds the same as 'he' in spoken Mandarin
cards.promptZh: 那个女人是我的妈妈，____很好。
cards.promptPinyin: nàge nǚrén shì wǒ de māma, ____ hěn hǎo.
cards.promptEn: That woman is my mom, ____ (she) is very nice.

cards.promptZh: 门外面是____？是我的朋友。
cards.promptPinyin: mén wàimiàn shì ____? shì wǒ de péngyou.
cards.promptEn: ____ (Who) is outside the door? It's my friend.

cards.notes: Refers to people of Chinese descent living abroad
cards.promptZh: 不住在中国、但是是中国人的人，我们叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: bú zhù zài zhōngguó, dànshì shì zhōngguó rén de rén, wǒmen jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: People who are ethnically Chinese but don't live in China are called ____ (overseas Chinese).

cards.promptZh: 在学校教书、教学生的人叫____。
cards.promptPinyin: zài xuéxiào jiāo shū, jiāo xuéshēng de rén jiào ____.
cards.promptEn: A person who teaches students at school is a ____ (teacher).
